accordion.shippingContent: Dispatched within one working day. 3–5 working days islandwide, longer to some outstation areas.
accordion.careContent: Machine wash cold, inside out. Line dry in shade. Warm iron on the reverse.
accordion.returnsContent: 7-day returns on unworn items with tags attached. Because nothing is personalised, all returned stock is resellable.

hero.headline: See it before you wear it
hero.subhead: Cotton sarees with unstitched jacket material — recolour any design, compare Plain and Super Cotton, and preview it draped either way before you buy.

osariya.heading: One saree, two drapes
osariya.body: Every saree can be draped the traditional way or as a Kandyan Osariya — same fabric, same price, same item shipped.

proof.heading: From our customers
proof.placeholderNote: Customer photo reviews will appear here once published.

pdp.colourPromiseBody: This material is photographed in natural daylight, with one unedited reference frame published for its colourway. If the delivered item differs materially from that reference, we collect it at our cost and replace or refund in full.
pdp.reviewsNone: Customer photo reviews will appear here once published.
pdp.outOfStockLabel: This colourway is out of stock.

jacketPage.title: Jacket Material
jacketPage.standaloneNote: Order jacket material on its own — no saree required.
jacketPage.deliveryNote: A flat delivery fee applies to jacket-only orders, shown at checkout before you pay.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Delivery, returns, colour accuracy and care — the questions we're asked most, answered plainly.
support.contactBody: Reach us on WhatsApp for the fastest response, or by phone during service hours.
support.colourPromiseBody: Every material is photographed in natural daylight, with one unedited reference frame published per colourway. If a delivered item differs materially from that reference, we collect it at our cost and replace or refund it in full. The Design Your Own preview is a rendered approximation and is not covered by this promise — see the honesty note in the configurator.
support.jacketStitchingBody: Your jacket material ships unstitched, cut to the piece length stated on the listing. Take it to your regular tailor along with your measurements — we don't take measurements or stitch, so any tailor of your choice can complete it.

policies.pending: This page is pending final legal review and will be published before launch. For questions in the meantime, reach us on WhatsApp.

signInEmail.subject: Your Lunara sign-in code
signInEmail.body: Your sign-in code is {code}. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
signInEmail.ignore: If you didn't ask for this code, you can ignore this email. Never share this code with anyone.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: We'll email you a 6-digit code. No password needed.
signIn.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
signIn.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Check it, or request a new one.
signIn.sendFailed: We couldn't send the code. Try again in a moment.
signIn.claimFailed: You're signed in, but we couldn't add this order to your account. Contact us on WhatsApp and we'll sort it out.

ops.title: Operations
ops.pricesNote: Changes apply on the next page load. Customers with the item in their cart see the change marked beside it.

error.invalid: That wasn't valid. Check the values and try again.
error.conflict: Someone else changed this first. The page now shows the latest.
error.tracking: Courier and tracking number are required to dispatch.

messages.intro: WhatsApp and SMS messages to send by hand until those services are connected. Open, send, then mark as sent.

photos.intro: Photos are stored exactly as uploaded: no resizing, filters or colour changes. Upload sRGB JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 12 MB each, up to {max} gallery photos per colour. The first gallery photo is the cover shown in the shop.
photos.noPhotos: No photos yet — the shop shows a placeholder.
photos.referenceHint: One unretouched daylight photo with the colour target in frame. It can be set only once.
photos.referenceLocked: Set, and locked: a new fabric lot needs a new colourway record.
photos.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# photo uploaded.} other {# photos uploaded.}}

notifications.confirmed: Lunara: order {number} is confirmed. We'll let you know when it's packed.
notifications.packed: Lunara: order {number} is packed and will be dispatched shortly.

notifications.cancelled: Lunara: order {number} has been cancelled. If you didn't ask for this, reply here and we'll help.

notifications.deliveredDay14Subject: Share a photo of your Lunara saree?

saveOrder.body: Optional: save this order to an account to follow its delivery any time. We'll email you a 6-digit code — no password.
